phase_note: Generated 2026-10-04/05 by the Phase 10 spec batch (wave 2) in auto-approve mode. 10 requirements / 64 acceptance criteria; 13 design components; 6 major / 20 leaf tasks ((P): 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4; 6.4 maintainer-only). Research: three read-only Explore subagents (history, plans, benchmarks) in parallel plus main-context reading of metrics, model and the analytics-index contract; no DuckDB probe was needed; no research downgrade. Step 3.5 task-graph review ran as an independent reviewer dispatched by the controller, twice. Round 1: NEEDS_FIXES (4 blocking, 8 should-fix, 5 nit), all applied, including design.md fixes (corpus-table agreement sentences, day_rows beside history's _suppressed_day_indices, fit-ingest next-free numbering, the invalid-TOML profile caveat) and Req 8.5 narrowed to a malformed benchmark entry. Round 2: NEEDS_FIXES (3 should-fix, 1 housekeeping), applied without a third review because the skill bounds the loop at one re-review. Accepted trade-off: design.md exceeds the template's 1000-line advisory because it carries all eleven tables' column descriptions and two engine seams. Settled: four producers registered by append (one computed, three corpus); SCHEMA_VERSION advances to main's value + 1 at landing; mean-max constants in fitdocs.metrics.mean_max_sources outside fit-ingest's pinned CONSTANT_SOURCES.
